conf.description: Carbon Black EDR server audit log (ban/isolate/Live Response), tailed from /var/log/cb - no JSON form exists for this stream.

conf.comment: No literal sample audit line was in the work order. Only a leading timestamp and a 4-column CSV shape (timestamp,user,ip,description) are assumed from the documented Cb Response audit-log format; see README gap notes.

functions.description: Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
split the assumed 4-column audit CSV shape
lines that don't match the audit CSV shape are the server-component debug lines the work order says to drop at the edge
console operator and the free-text remainder
set event.dataset, drop the source IP column (not requested by the map) and consumed scratch fields
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
